testsuite.name: Security contract — SameSite cookie (M08 G8)

testcase.name: /auth/refresh игнорирует произвольный X-CSRF-TOKEN header (не ломает happy-path)
/auth/refresh без cookie → 401 (cross-origin attack blocked by cookie absence)
/auth/refresh с cookie БЕЗ X-CSRF-TOKEN header → 200 (regression guard)
/auth/logout clears cookie with same security attributes and Max-Age=0
login issues cookie with HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Strict + Path=/api/auth
